label: K-drama
summary: Korean drama episode: held looks and silences, slow push-ins on realisations, restrained acting, framing motifs.
source: Maestro guideline from K-drama conventions (see README); not measured on a corpus.

rhythm.note: hold a reaction until the look lands, then a beat of silence; fast cutting only for a shock

camera: mostly static; slow push-in on a realisation or contained anger; slow pull-out for isolation; gentle tracking on a walk; handheld only for panic
look: soft motivated light, one source per scene; cool blue nights, warm amber interiors
acting: restrained: emotion held behind the eyes; a look or a swallowed line instead of a gesture; tears well rather than fall; stillness before the reaction
motifs: frame-within-frame (door, window) for isolation, tighter = more trapped
a pole or shadow line between two people = distrust
a reflection for a divided self; rain for a turning point
hand inserts (a hand tightening, an almost-touch, a wrist grabbed)
dont: no runs of sub-2-second cuts outside a shock; no mugging
